title: Mochizuki Honami — Because You're Our Dear Friend〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-B

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Really...?!
Th-That was Honami?!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Shh! Not so loud, Otori!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Yeah, this isn't exactly something we want others spreading around.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: S-Sure, but...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Good morning.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Oh, Honami...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Good morning, Honami...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hm? Is something wrong?
You all seem so somber.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Why don't we just ask her to make sure?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, it could all be just a big misunderstanding.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Y-You're right... Let's ask!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Honami, there's something we need you to tell us...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Sure, what is it?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Yesterday, after school, we thought we heard you arguing with someone.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We were wondering if you were arguing like that because you were having a fight with them...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I thought that spot was secluded enough, but I guess it wasn't...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I appreciate your concern.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I really didn't mean to raise my voice like that, and I apologize for causing such a disturbance...

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: But it really was you, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Hold on, Honami can get that mad at people?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Noooo! That's not possible! Honami's a saint!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Yeah! Who's the one that made you do this?! Tell us!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Maybe it's okay to tell Emu and these two. I'd rather not make them worry more by giving them the wrong idea...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Please don't tell anyone else this, but I was with Shiho that time...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We were discussing something regarding our band and our conversation got a little out of hand...

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Oh, it was Hinomori... Now it makes sense...

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Yeah, she's like the most unwavering person I've ever met. I bet this isn't the first serious argument she's had with someone.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Maybe. You two both work so hard for your band too.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I really understand how you must've felt. I've had some not-so-nice conversations with people too and also had to raise my voice to them...

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Yeah, I totally get that. It's like, the more you take something seriously, the more you want others to do the same.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What's wrong with that?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And you're trying to go pro, right? You have to work together, which also means you're not always going to agree on everything.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(They're right...
And they've all experienced this before...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, but Shiho didn't actually do anything wrong in this case.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: She was just trying to do something for our band all by herself and I was just worried about what would happen to her if she went through with it...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So I told her that I didn't want her to suffer on her own and asked if I could help out somehow.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I didn't know that part...

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: So you had an argument, but also found a solution you both could agree on...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. So please, don't tell anyone else about what I just said.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Of course! Not one peep.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: As long as you're fine with that, Honami. I guess it really isn't something we should be telling others.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup yup♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Still, I was really surprised when I heard that you were who they were talking about, Honami...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I mean, this is Honami Mochizuki we're talking about☆

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (It really is important to clearly tell someone what you're feeling...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I don't enjoy raising my voice the way I did...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But it was something I had to do. Len was right. We aren't going to agree on everything and I have to express myself whenever a situation calls for it.)
